title: Public Interest Data and Transparency Laws
grammar: Verbs of transparency, access, and exemption (hozzáfér -hoz/-hez, eltekint -tól/-től)
goal: I can explain how anyone can ask a public body for public-interest data (közérdekű adatigénylés).
I can correctly use verbs governing the allative (hozzáfér valamihez) and ablative (eltekint valamitől) in transparency cases.
I can explain what the NAIH (National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information) does.
